methods_quotes.q: Confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated by using statistical analysis software to account for the multistage probability sample.
Estimates were age-adjusted to the standard 2000 U.S. population.
All differences noted are statistically significant (p<0.05) with nonoverlapping 95% CIs.
Data were adjusted for nonresponse and weighted to provide national estimates.
For this analysis, these respondents were classified as not having severe joint pain and were included in the denominator.
